headline: Biotechnology and Energy Lead ETF Rotations as Sector and Geographic Divergences Broaden
market_regime: Selective Leadership with Strong Commodity and Healthcare Rotations
executive_summary: Quantitative analysis reveals persistent leadership in Biotechnology (XBI) and Energy (XLE), with both ETFs achieving 63-bar score highs of 95.00 and 94.09 respectively. Emerging rotations are strengthening in Global Materials (MXI) and Peru (EPU), while defensive and interest-sensitive sectors like Utilities (XLU) remain confirmed in rotation out. Significant internal divergences exist within Consumer Discretionary, Industrials, and Health Care, where sub-industry performance splits sharply.
